caption: The drawing depicts three metal fireplace tools arranged vertically against a plain light background, each with gold and black coloration. On the left is a shovel with a long black handle, a rounded gold finial at the top, and a wide black blade. In the center is a tool featuring a large, ornate gold handle with decorative turns and a round medallion at the midpoint; its lower portion splits into two straight black prongs. On the right is a pair of tongs with a matching gold handle and decorative top, transitioning to two long, straight black arms that curve inward at the ends, each terminating in a rounded cup. The drawing includes two small horizontal rulers labeled "INCHES" at the base of the center and left tools, and the artist's name, "Hans Korsch," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Tongs and Shovel
